edits.old: CASE WHEN regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1)='' THEN 'Ungraded' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=5 THEN 'Entry Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=10 THEN 'Mid Level' WHEN try_cast(regexp_extract(compensation_grade_id,'([0-9]+)',1) AS INTEGER)<=15 THEN 'Senior Level' ELSE 'Executive Level' END

edits.new: SELECT o.organization_id,o.source_relation,o.organization_name,o.organization_type,o.organization_sub_type,o.staffing_model,m.current_employee_count,m.organization_health_score,m.annual_turnover_rate,m.performance_category,m.organization_size_category FROM staging.stg_workday__organization o LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_workday__organization_metrics m USING(organization_id,source_relation)
